author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Dow Jones Stock Caterpillar Leads Stock Market Sell-Off | Investor's Business Daily

organizations.name: caterpillar stock crumbles among the dow jones

text:
The major stock indexes sold off early Monday with the Dow Jones industrials falling more than 350 points in today's stock market . Dow Jones stock Caterpillar ( CAT ) plunged after its big earnings miss. Meanwhile, graphics-chip maker Nvidia ( NVDA ) crashed 15% on lowered revenue guidance.
X The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite fell 1.6%. The S&P 500 index dropped 1.3%, while the Dow Jones industrials lost 1.5%. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Dow Jones Stocks: Caterpillar Stock Crumbles Among the Dow Jones stocks, Caterpillar crumbled 8% on weaker-than-expected earnings results . Caterpillar is considered a bellwether for the global economy. Caterpillar stock is back below its 50-day line, as the stock trades about 25% off its 52-week high.
Meanwhile, a number of other Dow Jones stocks are on tap this week for earnings, including Apple ( AAPL ), Boeing ( BA ), Microsoft ( MSFT ) and Visa ( V ). While Apple stock lingers over 34% off its 52-week high, Boeing stock, Microsoft stock and Visa stock are nearing buy points .

Please contact customer service CLOSE Stock Market Earnings: Nvidia Stock Plunges Chip stocks were sharply lower Monday after graphics-chip maker Nvidia cut its revenue guidance in the current quarter. The company cited "deteriorating macroeconomic conditions, particularly in China." Nvidia stock declined 15%, just days after regaining its 50-day line.
Rival Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) declined 8%, while top growth stock Broadcom ( AVGO ) fell 2%. Broadcom stock is just under a 261.69 buy point after today's decline. On the upside, Xilinx ( XLNX ) trimmed losses to just 0.1%. Xilinx stock soared to a breakout above a 95.28 buy point last week.
This week, a number of top stocks will report quarterly earnings , including PayPal ( PYPL ). PayPal stock is set to report Wednesday after the stock market close. The top payment processor dropped below its 93.80 buy point after Monday's more than 2% drop. The stock broke out Friday.
According to the IBD Stock Checkup , PayPal stock boasts a 97 out of highest-possible 99 IBD Composite Rating. The Composite Rating is a blend of key fundamental and technical metrics designed to gauge a stock's leadership qualities.
IBD 50 Stocks Falter Amid Stock Market Sell-Off Among the leading growth stocks , the vast majority of IBD 50 stocks were trading in the red in morning trade. Software stock Atlassian ( TEAM ) fell about 2% amid a recent four-day rebound. Shares reversed sharply lower on Jan. 18, following the company's earnings results.
Meanwhile, retail stock Lululemon ( LULU ) dropped nearly 2%, as it continues to shape the right side of a new cup-shaped base.
